scientific_integrity: Constructive integral nerve and acyclic-Morse proof; standalone exhaustive enumeration and independent mod-two checks, no external audit.
scientific_limitations: Only two directed pentagons sharing one vertex, six grains and the four specified shifts; no infinite-family or persistence formula. Full original public primary text was read; later revision and some indexed literature were not available in full.
title: Three homotopy phases from a shifted vacancy on a directed pentagonal rose
